title: The Price-Drop Guarantee on an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking
content:
Where the identical Air Ticket Fare Brands itinerary in the identical fare brand is publicly offered for less within the price-match window of the brand held, the difference is settled to the original form of payment up to the brand's ceiling.

## 1. How the comparison is made

The window is measured from ticket issue, and the comparison is made against the brand's own public price on the same booking channel. A price found on a different channel or in a different brand is not a match.

## 2. Where no cash settlement is allowed

A brand that does not allow a cash settlement refuses the claim outright, and no voucher is offered in its place.

## 3. How often

1 settlement is made per booking however many drops occur, and a settled booking is not compared again.

## 4. What the settlement is raised against

The settlement is raised against the original base-fare line and never against taxes, carrier fees or the agency service fee.

## 5. Where the itinerary has changed

A claim raised after the traveller has changed the itinerary is refused, because the itinerary compared is no longer the itinerary ticketed.

## 6. The amount

The amount settled is the brand's ceiling or the amount paid on the booking, whichever is the lower of the two.

| The claim | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| identical itinerary, identical brand, same channel, inside the window, brand allows a cash settlement | settled to the original form of payment, up to the brand's ceiling |
| same itinerary found in a different brand or on a different channel | not a match |
| brand does not allow a cash settlement | refused outright; no voucher in its place |
| a second claim on a booking already settled | not compared again |
| a claim raised after the itinerary has been changed | refused |

## 7. Hypothetical figures

A hypothetical booking on a brand whose ceiling is 300.00 USD meets a public price 220.00 USD lower on the same channel inside the window. The lower of the ceiling and the amount paid governs the settlement, and 220.00 USD is settled against the original base-fare line. Were a second drop of 100.00 USD to follow, no further settlement is made, because 1 settlement is made per booking.
